notes.title: The Minor League Update
notes.content:
Hey baseball fans!

We're glad to present you our latest update for [b]Astonishing Baseball Manager[/b]: a new complete minor team system!

Historically, in AB, you could only send major leaguers to your minor team, and only manage those, disregarding the other members of the team. No more!
Your minor team will now display every minor leaguer in it, allowing you to see their progress through time, and calling them up if you find them promising!

We're also introducing some UI improvements and bug fixes, in order to improve even more your baseball experience!

[b]Complete changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] New minor team system
[*] UI improvements for the front office, the draft, the offseason and more
[*] Bug fixes for achievements, the draft, superstars and relievers
[/list]

See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: Astonishing Baseball 24 is here!
notes.content:
[b]Astonishing Baseball 24[/b] is now available on Steam!

This new edition brings tons of new content and exciting features, like new player portraits, and bounties, a new way to select the daily tasks you want, in order to get more training points!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/8e495ca928c12a1852e39b585da5b7484c487e82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/3cc1231457691d54a03a43a924d76ecfc609dedc.jpg[/img]

But that's not all! We've also refined the hard mode difficulty to make it more interesting, improved the transactions screen, and revamped the way ranked games are played online!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New minor league system (engine only)
[*] Brand new player portraits
[*] The transactions screen now feature league-wide transactions as well
[*] The bounties: a new way to pick the daily tasks you want
[*] A brand new online ranked screen!
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved hard mode (should be closer to intermediate difficulty in ABK now)
[*] Improved AI for trades
[*] New options for the stats in the lineup screen
[*] New sorting for mods
[*] Rankings now include more players
[*] More content for the bleachers
[/list]

While this is all for now, you can expect to see more this season, starting with the complete new minor team system, where you will be able to manage and call up minor leaguers!
We hope you will like this new update, and feel free to share your feedback on the Steam forum, by email, or on Discord!

See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: The Astonishing Baseball 23 Update!
notes.content:
Hey baseball fans!

I'm proud to announce our biggest update of the year! [b]Astonishing Baseball[/b] for Steam has finally received a big engine update. Which means better AI, better simulations, and plenty of new features!

This is the first of two major updates we'll release this year. Another big update is being prepared, and will be available this summer. 

If you see anything unusual in this update, or if you have any suggestions, feel free to drop me an email!

Meanwhile, here's the complete changelog of this big update!

[b]New features[/b]

[list]
[*] A new award: the “Most Improved Player” trophy!
[*] Players will now become friends or rivals with their teammates, generating messages from the bleachers
[*] Players will now send you message from time to time to share what’s on their mind
[*] Grades have been added to the lineup screen, to make it easier for beginners to start
[*] Completely revamped AI for free agents
[/list]

[b]Improvements and changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Bug fixes for international scouting
[*] Fully training a player will now give them a +1 potential bonus, if they still have potential left
[*] Legendary players you receive from the shop will now always be young
[*] The Hall of Fame team selection process has been improved, which means players won’t always join their last team anymore
[*] Reaching certain milestones as a coach will trigger messages
[*] Defense is now considered when pricing contracts
[*] New meta for contract negotiation
[*] More players will now appear as potential front office members
[/list]

See you at the ballpark!
Aerilys

notes.title: The franchise player update!
notes.content:
Hey baseball fans! Happy new year!

Let's start 2023 the right way: with a brand new game mode! 
[b]The Franchise Player[/b] mode allows you to play the career of your very own batter. Join a team and help it win the Baseball Cup, or go from city to city as a journeyman. Sign with prestigious sponsors, and collect the best bats in the world!

This is a beta feature for now, so you can expect a few issues. If you encounter any problem, or have any suggestion, feel free to drop me an email!

We have more in store for Astonishing Baseball in 2023. Thanks for being part of this adventure!

notes.title: Welcome to the World Cup
notes.content:
Hey baseball fans!

This week's update is a great one! Two big features have been added, and bunch of smaller ones are also joining the party!
The first new feature is the "World Cup". This mini-event takes place every 4 years, during Spring Training. You will be asked if you want to take charge of an international baseball team, and lead them to victory! This is a nice break from the regular season. It's also a great feeling to play with stars from the entire league!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/df451fc77184f8484d5d25dc5067239e699e2d37.jpg[/img]

The second new feature is the "Bleachers' message" editor. This will allow you to post your own messages to the social network of the game. And this includes the possibility of running "polls". You can finally ask your fans what kind of popcorn they really want (and it's not the one with cheese). Is it a very useful feature? No. Is it fun though? yes, definitely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/a39b9fd8fb6f7bb76e96b59d1cd9a7daeddfadf9.jpg[/img]

Finally, this update includes a bunch of other changes, like the possibility to edit the name of any coach in the league, new team logos, and an improved logo picker! Check the complete list below for more info!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] World Cup
[*] "Bleachers' message" editor
[*] Edit the name of any coach in the league
[*] New team logos
[*] Improved logo picker
[*] Colors are now sorted during the creation of a custom team
[*] A few bug fixes for the Prodigy mode (thanks Andy!)
[/list]

[h2]Help us improve the game![/h2]

This week, I have a special request: I've prepared a survey to see how I can improve the Steam version of Astonishing Baseball. I kept it short, and any feedback would be appreciated. Thanks in advance for your time!
https://a.sprig.com/cjFicHZhWFl5RGZzfnNpZDowY2VkYmExMy05ZjExLTQxNmItOTJkOC1iMWZhMjU2M2Y0OWU=

notes.title: A Prodigious Update!
notes.content:
Hi baseball fans!

This week we bring you a big update, with not one but two major features!
The first one is "The Prodigy". In this mini-mode, you will take care of a future prospect, going from high school all the way to your graduation! Not only you have to take care of upgrading their stats, but also take very important decisions: do you train or study? Do you go to a college in Seattle or Paris? Do you play baseball or go out with your teammates? And most importantly, should you go to the Halloween party with your best friend or the girl of your dreams? There's no wrong answer (or so they say).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/70824dc6813c868859156548d8143199a9236f03.png[/img]

The second new feature is the ability to go deeper in the training of your players. Until now, training was only improving hitting or pitching. But now, you can choose to also train power, speed, or the accuracy of your pitchers! Of course, all your previous training is still there, and keeps the same efficiency. This means that the new system just allows you to make your players even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181468/0b7e9db13badf89c0d6406929abfcce1d8f839cc.png[/img]

Finally, remember to check out the amazing God Mode DLC if you haven't yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2082240/Astonishing_Baseball__God_Mode/

More is to come, so stay around for next week's update!
See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: Updating the engine
notes.content:
Greetings baseball fans!

There hasn't been an update in a while, and it's because I've been busy upgrading the game's simulation engine! Indeed, the Steam version of Astonishing Baseball was based off the simulation engine used in AB21 for mobile. But many improvements have been added in the 22 edition. That's why I took some time to finally port it to the PC version. Not only this means new features, but also that it will be easier to bring new stuff in the future!

Here's a short but non-exhaustive list of the new features:
[list]
[*] New awards and competitions, like "Les jeux de Paris" and the "Scout of the year" title
[*] Improved base-running, stealing and defense simulations, especially for catchers
[*] You can now pick your difficulty when creating a save. Hard and extreme settings will bring new challenges to your clubhouse!
[*] Improved stadium simulation
[*] The shop is now open (beta)
[*] Improved AB magazine, with more content than ever!
[/list]

This new update has been tested a lot, but if you see any issue, feel free to report it at support[at]astonishing-sports.app!

Special thanks to Andy for his many tests and bug reports!
See you at the ballpark!

notes.title: Become a Star
notes.content:
We were all hoping to see the first games of this spring by now. But baseball continues to live here! 

This week's update brings many small improvements and bug fixes. But most of all, it increases by 50% the rewards earned from daily and weekly tasks. A real game changer!

[b]More Training points for PC players[/b]
After a few conversations with some PC players, it became clear that training points were too hard to get. The carefully crafted balance that works on mobile was not good enough for the Steam version, where several sources of TP are not available.
In this update, tasks are now giving 50% more training points. Besides that, the "train a player" task is also giving a bit more TP. This should make your coaching life easier now ;)

[b]Features and improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] More training points can be earned from daily and weekly tasks
[*] New header images for the next game screen
[*] Improved bios for minor coaches
[*] Rings have been added to the HOF players
[*] Improved pinch-hitting display
[*] Improved Biggest FA contracts message
[*] New default logo for Cleveland
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Front office coach training has been fixed
[*] The Baseball Cup MVP title is now given after the final game, as it should be!
[*] Bug fix for ballpark earnings and souvenirs
[*] Display fix for potential minor team coaches
[*] The last starter task is now triggered on the correct day
[*] Corrections for interviews
[*] Various fixes for tasks
[/list]

notes.title: V1.03 - Scripted Update
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow baseball fans!

Let's start the week the right way with a new update for Astonishing Baseball! Thanks to your feedback, I've been able to fix a number of bugs. But because I didn't want to just ship fixes, I thought it would be cool to add a new feature as well. So here are scenarios!

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/533101174988210177/935193398749581323/AB21_5D8ECA6.jpg[/img]

Scenarios are new ways to enjoy the game. You can either decide to travel in time and play as an old dynasty, or try to beat one of the available challenges. The latest include [i]The Detroit Challenge[/i], which is an excellent way to actually test your skills!

Thank you to everybody for your support, and keep sending me feedback! Also, special thanks to Andy, who's been incredibly helpful since the release of the game. Also special mention to Nightkeep3r and Aton, my special Steam advisors on Discord ;)

Have an astonishing week!


[h3]Complete Changelog[/h3]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The stadium's back button will now stay in place instead of scrolling
[*] The draft page will now scroll up when switching between batters and pitchers
[*] The search screen can now return up to 99 results (instead of 50)
[*] A button will now appear when an international prospect is available
[*] The max length of a city's name during the save creation has been doubled to 32 characters
[*] When adding a custom logo to your team in the front office page, the custom logo will now appear right after the info have been saved
[*] The position of the top menu in main screens is now fixed instead of jumping all over the place
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The minor team screen can now scroll when you have a lot of players
[*] Improved display of hits during a game
[*] Scroll for the bullpen dialog
[*] No more mention of multiplayer for now ;)
[*] Scouts XP are now correctly saved
[*] Typos
[/list]
